description: This file defines an interface IPasswordHasher for hashing passwords asynchronously, including a method to hash a password with a salt and it extends IDisposable for resource management.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: Interface for a password hashing service that supports asynchronous hashing and resource cleanup.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password with a provided salt, returning the hash as a byte array.
